Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a bold, extraordinarily refined minimal web section concept for 8x Social, a creator-network company. This is a NEW replacement for a rejected conventional testimonial design. Do not draw testimonials, logo rows, cards or tab lists. A single visual idea. Make it look like a designer's finished browser screenshot, not an illustration or a moodboard. Landscape 1536x1024.

REFERENCE 1 is a real creator video still of Jack. Use this actual frame as the photographic source and preserve the person, hair, gesture and candid smartphone character; don't turn him into a polished synthetic model. Reference 2 is the preceding section for warm stone colour and typography ONLY. Do not repeat that layout or that woman's image. Photography is a monochrome treatment of Jack's real frame. This is the next section immediately below the warm stone Day-to-day section. Continue identical pale warm stone #e9e5dc through the whole frame. No panel backgrounds or room scene, no new hero/nav/footer, no texture overlay across the UI.

Design concept: “Real voices. Wider reach.” The signature dot is the way a photographic voice becomes a graphic language. Create ONE dramatic large square editorial visual in the RIGHT HALF, approximately x=760 to1410, y=140 to810. It is a fine black-and-white photographic print of the supplied young creator, face clearly recognizable, with black T-shirt treatment if needed but no invented jewellery or props. The LEFT two thirds of this visual retain detailed continuous-tone photography including the whole face; ONLY its outer right quarter and lower edge gradually resolve into an exquisitely precise halftone of round black dots on the SAME stone background as the website. Dots progressively reduce in diameter and become more widely spaced outward, clean regular print-screen alignment, never random particles or smoke. The image has no hard rectangular boundary on its right or bottom. A restrained small cluster of about twelve orange dots near its lower-right edge provides one little brand accent. It must feel like premium monochrome editorial print meeting an interactive native web surface. Preserve realistic skin and source facial identity, no AI-smooth skin, no giant 3D spheres, no fake fabric, no floating phone mockup. The dots must be unmistakable but composed and spacious. Do not add a second portrait, no giant circle, no previous hero montage.

LEFT HALF: beautifully spaced black sans-serif typography on stone, top aligns around y300, headline exact text “Real voices.” on line1 and “Wider reach.” on line2. Confident medium-weight grotesk, enormous but calm, around75px, tight optical kerning, not extra bold, black. Only the full stop at the end is orange. Beneath generous 30px space, one short explanatory sentence split into two lines: “Creator content, made for the platforms your audience uses.” in20px, quiet charcoal, leftwidth420px. Beneath 45px space, one understated text link exact “Build your network” with a thin diagonal arrow. Beneath another50px, a SMALL understated horizontal line of simple black TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts glyphs, not app tiles or badges, with only their names below in readable small type. These indicate distribution destinations, not fake metrics. No numbers, no chart, no testimonials, no decorative labels.

Leave generous page margins and open space above/below. At the absolute top, one fine horizontal grey rule at y50 within the shared margins hints that this is a continuous page, not a new scene. No thick seam, no colour change, no background gradient. Two columns with deliberate asymmetry, one photograph, one headline, tiny platform marks. Main dot treatment should resemble an expertly made fine raster print fading into the website's existing paper surface. The final image must be visually striking through composition and realism, with few elements and no decorative noise.
